notes.title: small update v1.1.05 - bug fixes and game play updates
notes.notes:
[h1] Our first update for Shadow of The Forgotten includes many bug fixes and a small update[/h1]

[h2]Game Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] made the story notes more clear to find
[*] added & changed a couple of hints for the puzzles 
[*] changed enemy response time 
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed a bug for chapter 2 were the camera fails to capture the enemy 
[*] fixed a bug for chapter 2 were the enemy sound is delayed 
[*] fixed a bug for chapter 2 were the enemy gets stuck on objects and the sound keeps loping
[/list]
 
[h3]thank you for everyone who keeps sending us feed-back, we will try our best to apply fixes as soon as possible[/h3]
